messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: inference-high-latency (99th percentile > 3s) for /v1/embeddings route

sara: I'm paged, looking at traffic and backpressure now
alex: embeddings traffic spiked ~6x starting 09:12 UTC, spike concentrated on route /v1/embeddings-hot and a handful of noisy API keys
mike: Is it regional?
jess: Mainly us-east-1 and eu-west-1, ap-south looks normal so far
kai: Any customer-facing errors or just slow tails?
alex: Mostly slow tails and retries; some clients hitting client-side timeouts. Error rate up modestly (~0.6% 5xx) due to upstream timeouts on heavy rerank requests
sara: Quick mitigation proposal (live):
1) reduce per-endpoint default quota for embeddings route from 120 rps -> 40 rps (global default)
2) apply route-specific limit: /v1/embeddings-hot -> 20 rps per API key
3) bump chat route priority for paid accounts so chat remains unaffected (no quota change)
4) temporarily disable non-enterprise rerank feature (rerank flag = off) to remove heavy downstream fanout
Anyone object? :thinking:
mike: sounds good. prefer to throttle embeddings over chat. Agree disable rerank for non-enterprise customers briefly
jess: if we throttle too hard we'll spike erroring clients — recommend gradual step: 120 -> 80 -> 40 over 3 minutes, watch retries
sara: ok will do stepwise change

sara: running config change now (ops command)
```bash
curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.internal/v1/configs/quotas \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "route": "/v1/embeddings",
    "staged_steps": [80, 40],
    "per_key_limit": 20,
    "apply_mode": "live"
  }'
```

deploy-bot: Config change accepted (run_id=run-7f3a). Applying step 1 -> 80 rps

jess: metrics: embeddings tail p99 down from 4.2s -> 2.6s after step 1, errors stable
alex: starting rerank disable for non-enterprise (feature-flag toggle)

sara: feature flag API:
```json
POST /featureflags/toggle
{ "flag": "rerank_non_enterprise", "value": false, "actor": "ops" }
```
deploy-bot: Feature flag updated (ff-run=ff-12b). Rerank disabled for non-enterprise groups

mike: monitoring dashboards show latency improving — p99 ~1.8s now in us-east-1
kai: CS: are high-volume customers impacted? we need to notify the ones we throttle
cs-lead: I'll draft short note to top 8 impacted customers (IDs: C-101, C-213, C-314...). Will include ETA and repro steps. Do we want to offer temporary traffic migration to dedicated endpoints?
sara: yes, add note that enterprise customers on Dedicated not affected. Offer invite to trial Dedicated for high volume accounts

alex: one anomaly: a single API key accounted for ~28% of hot route requests, I'm flagging it for throttling and outreach
sara: manual per-key throttle applied to that key -> 5 rps; watch for churn
jess: second step completed: general default moved to 40 rps now (run_id=run-7f3a-step2). p99 stable ~1.6s across regions
mike: handoff: I'll stay on for next 2 hours and keep pages open. sara, please prepare incident summary and actions for postmortem
sara: will write summary and follow-up action items (rate-limit tuning, detection for noisy keys, improve rerank cost accounting). I'll also schedule a postmortem tomorrow 11:00 UTC

incident-bot: Incident marked "mitigated" by sara at 09:29 UTC — active monitoring continuing

cs-lead: Sent customer notif to top 8; one asked for a call, scheduling now

sara: thanks everyone. final note: next steps — automate per-route graceful degradation rules, add auto-scaling guardrail for embeddings, and add an eval to measure rerank cost impact

mike: closing handoff, will update if anything regresses :thumbsup:
